headline: Executive order creates a federal task force made up of several agencies to work on reuniting separated families.
what_it_does: This order sets up a task force made up of several federal agencies. Based on its title, the task force's job is to work on reuniting families who were separated. No summary was provided, so details such as which families are covered, which agencies take part, and what powers or deadlines the task force has are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Families who were separated, including parents and children
who_it_affects.how: The task force is meant to work on bringing these family members back together.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies named to the task force
who_it_affects.how: These agencies would have to take part in and coordinate the reunification work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 2, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
